title: Complete flags of locally direct summands in a finite free module
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $n\in\mathbf N$. A complete linear flag in $A^n$ is an increasing sequence $0=F_0\subseteq\cdots\subseteq F_n=A^n$ of embedded $A$-submodules such that $A^n/F_i$ is finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module], with rank $n-i$ at every prime of $A$ (the rank of its localization over the corresponding local ring). Equivalently, each $F_i$ is locally on $\operatorname{Spec}A$ a free direct summand of rank $i$. For a ring map $f:A\to B$, define the scalar image of an embedded submodule $N\subseteq A^n$ to be the $B$-span [def-weil-submodule-span] of the vectors $(f(v_j))_j$ for $v\in N$; this is the image of $B\otimes_A N\to B^n$. The sequence of these images is the scalar extension of a flag.
